summary: Checked a retained claim against its original basis and corrected it, with no measurement or judgment change. The value-adoption account had attributed the committed peer's protection to the Cmds-nil branch at epaxos/epaxos.go:807, but the source shows the opposite: handleCommit returns immediately when the instance is already COMMITTED (line 1082), and for such an instance handlePreAccept performs no mutation at all because its only write behind the Status >= ACCEPTED guard sits inside the inst.Cmds == nil condition (lines 807-813), which is false for a replica holding the committed command. The counterevidence item now states that the protection is the absence of a writer rather than a guard, and that the contradiction is therefore between two replicas' decided values rather than a silent rewrite at the holder; the statement, the three executed witnesses, the other counterevidence items and the limits are unchanged. With this correction the four explained questions, the three asserted defects (value replacement with a completed committed-value contradiction, the boundary-measured recovery-authority gate, and the per-attempt status-guard stall) and the holds account for client completion all rest on retained receipts whose cited claims have now been spot-checked against the fixed source.
